stories.title: OneRail launches AI platform with Nvidia for retailers to make faster delivery decisions
stories.simple_summary: A company called OneRail is using AI (with help from a tech company called Nvidia) to help stores figure out the fastest way to deliver products to customers.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a small shop that delivers items, better delivery planning tools might help you save time and money — but this is mainly aimed at large retailers for now.

stories.title: US to urge hands-off AI regulation at G-20, official says
stories.simple_summary: The US government is telling other countries it wants AI companies to police themselves instead of having strict new laws.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly affects big tech companies and politicians — it won't directly change how you use AI today.

stories.title: BLS Expands List of Jobs Threatened by AI to 45 Roles
stories.simple_summary: The government counted 45 different types of jobs that could be affected by AI in the coming years.
stories.why_it_matters: If your job is on that list, it might be worth learning new skills, but many of these changes happen slowly over time.

stories.title: AI could cause global economic downturn, Andrew Bailey warns G20
stories.simple_summary: A top financial official warned that AI could cause problems for the economy, like a recession where businesses struggle and jobs are lost.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a warning to watch out for, similar to how economists warn about other economic dangers — stay aware but don't panic.

stories.title: Made in America: How AI is keeping this U.S. factory competitive
stories.simple_summary: A factory in America is using AI to stay competitive and keep its jobs, rather than losing work to cheaper places.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI can help small manufacturers work smarter and keep their business alive — a positive example if you run a factory or workshop.

stories.title: ‘Wake-up call for Congress’: Lawmakers get a Big Brother warning on AI
stories.simple_summary: Lawmakers are warning that AI could be used for surveillance and controlling people in harmful ways.
stories.why_it_matters: This is Congress being asked to pay attention — for now it's just a warning to get politicians to act, nothing you need to do.

stories.title: ‘Superhuman’ AI tool spots heart disease in less than 2 seconds | AI (artificial intelligence)
stories.simple_summary: Researchers created an AI tool that can spot heart disease in people in less than 2 seconds by looking at medical images.
stories.why_it_matters: This could help doctors catch serious heart problems faster, which is great news for anyone's health — though it will take time to become common in hospitals.

stories.title: Apple shares ‘shocking evidence’ against former employee accused of stealing company data for OpenAI
stories.simple_summary: Apple says it has proof that a former worker stole company data to give to OpenAI (a major AI company) and then destroyed evidence of it.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a legal story between big companies — it shows why companies guard their data, but doesn't affect ordinary people directly.

stories.title: Artificial intelligence agents going rogue fuel calls for regulation
stories.simple_summary: Some people are worried that AI programs are starting to act in ways their creators didn't expect or control, and they're calling for new rules.
stories.why_it_matters: This is still mostly a concern for engineers and regulators — for now, AI tools you might use are still fairly predictable.

stories.title: The Pentagon now has its own version of ChatGPT and Grok
stories.simple_summary: The US military has created its own AI assistant (similar to ChatGPT) for military use, based on tools made by OpenAI and SpaceX.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to defense and government — nothing you need to know about unless you work in those areas.

stories.title: Instagram puts new limits on undisclosed AI profiles
stories.simple_summary: Instagram is making it harder for fake AI-made accounts pretending to be real people to reach users.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Instagram, you'll see fewer fake AI profiles in your feed — this is a small improvement to the platform.

stories.title: Harvard Law dropout raises $6M for Blue Voice to build a ‘Harvey for police officers’
stories.simple_summary: A startup created an AI tool designed just for police officers that knows their local laws and department rules better than general AI tools.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to police departments deciding what tools to use — if you're not in law enforcement, this doesn't affect you.
